name: explain-algorithms-with-code
description: Explains algorithms with code and provides a step-by-step process of how they work.
prompt_template: # Explain the <ALGORITHM> algorithm and provide a step-by-step process of how it works. Include code snippets and examples.

examples.expected_behavior: provide a detailed explanation of the BFS algorithm with code snippets
explain the sliding window protocol with a step-by-step process and code examples

name: describe-technical-concepts
description: Describes technical concepts and provides key features and characteristics.
prompt_template: # Describe the <CONCEPT> and provide its key features and characteristics.

examples.expected_behavior: provide a detailed explanation of 5G technology and its key features
explain the Prometheus monitoring system and its key characteristics

name: explain-technologies-with-examples
description: Explains technologies and provides examples of how they work.
prompt_template: # Explain the <TECHNOLOGY> and provide examples of how it works.

examples.expected_behavior: explain AI agents and provide examples of how they work
explain the Grafana platform and provide examples of its key features
